name: maiden_orange
description: Maiden Orange is a light and festive slab serif font inspired by custom hand lettered 1950s advertisements. Clean and legible, while also being offbeat and friendly, this font lends itself to a wide variety of uses. From children's stories to the retro inspired, take Maiden Orange for a spin.
